title: Suki Seokyeong Kang
subtitle: Commonwealth
body: Suki Seokyeong Kang’s Commonwealth stages a series of quiet interventions that test the thresholds between the gallery and the world outside it. Working with cast bronze, water, and living plants, Akhavan turns architectural conventions — the plinth, the backdrop, the doorway — into sites of tension where hospitality and surveillance, refuge and exposure, are held in delicate balance.
